incident.description: Multiple failed login attempts were detected against an administrator account.

retrieved_knowledge:
Technique: Brute Force
ID: T1110
Description: Adversaries may use brute force techniques to gain access to accounts by systematically attempting passwords or other authentication information.
Detection: Multiple failed authentication attempts may indicate brute force activity.
Response: Temporarily lock or restrict the targeted account, Monitor the source IP address, Investigate authentication logs, Reset credentials if compromise is suspected, Enable or enforce multi-factor authentication

Technique: Password Guessing
ID: T1110.001
Description: Adversaries may attempt to gain access to accounts by repeatedly guessing passwords.
Detection: Repeated authentication failures targeting a specific account can indicate password guessing.
Response: Apply account lockout policies, Monitor authentication attempts, Investigate the source IP, Reset affected credentials
